_comment: TDD M4 reverse named-effort slice, native-path control: a Responses-native route keeps the existing raw-body bypass, so reasoning.effort plus unknown fields and bigint forward byte-equal with no loss report. GREEN on baseline and must stay GREEN (no native-path mutation in this unit).
name: m4_reasoning_responses_chat_native_responses_fidelity
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.localresp]
dialect = "openai-responses"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}/v1"
api_key = "resp-secret"

[[models]]
name = "resp-model"
provider = "localresp"
model = "resp-model"
